title: Weather Friends
yt_description:
Learn about different types of weather with Pip and friends. This song teaches toddlers about sun, rain, wind, and snow. Sing along and have fun!

🎵 Weather Friends

Hello
I'm Pip
Let's play

Sun is shining
Rain is falling
Wind is blowing

Weather, weather
Every day
Different sky

Snow is falling
Winter is here
Let's play

Weather, weather
Every day
Different sky
Bye bye

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
